meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 遇到难题时，Claude会召集4-6位不同思维原型（如建筑师、逆向者）逐一陈述立场、推理、风险和意外洞见，且必须存在实质分歧。最后输出综合报告：共识点、核心矛盾、盲区、建议路径、信心等级和留给你思考的一个问题。
howto.when: 当用户想获得多元观点、需要帮助做艰难决定，或说出“council mode”“mind council”等请求时触发；面临两难或无明确答案的复杂选择时也会启动。

say.text: 用深度委员会模式分析我该不该辞职创业。
say.note: 会展开6位成员的详细审议。

say.text: 开个快速委员会，评估我们的新营销方案。
加入逆向者和共情者，讨论远程办公是否公平。
say.note: 按指定原型定制委员会。

howto.what_en: Summon 4-6 archetypes (Architect, Contrarian, etc.) per question. Each states position, reasoning, risk, insight and must substantively disagree with another. Output synthesis: convergence, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, confidence level, one question to sit with.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user seeks diverse viewpoints, needs help on a difficult choice, uses phrases like 'council mode', 'mind council', or faces a dilemma/trade-off with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Deep council: should I quit my job to start a company?
Quick council: evaluate our new marketing plan.
say_en.note: Three members give a fast answer.

say_en.text: Add Contrarian and Empath to discuss remote-work fairness.
